submitted_runs.latest_observation: Submitted after patching the 235B launchers to pass policy.model_name explicitly and patching Megatron checkpoint-complete detection to require iter_0000000/run_config.yaml. The job completed 4/4 steps at 17:50 PDT with ExitCode 0:0. Ray workers were online at 128/128, the driver log confirmed policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 plus the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 speculative_config, vLLM V1 engine initialization with enforce_eager=false and CUDA Graph mode, target safetensors loading to 118/118, and the observed 1/1 drafter safetensors load. Steps 1-4 emitted completed Generation Worker Group and E2E metrics. Generated throughput is 63.70, 43.39, 73.58, and 61.78 generated tok/s/GPU with acceptance 62.82%, 69.01%, 65.82%, and 65.20%. Mean generated throughput is 60.61 tok/s/GPU, mean acceptance is 65.71%, mean E2E throughput is 43.60 tok/s/GPU, and mean total step time is 475.04s. Scheduler gate metrics show enabled_ratio=1.0 and disabled=0 for all 4 steps, and runner logs show active requests ranging from 1 to 64 with per-worker scheduled tokens up to 128 under token_threshold=4096. This confirms the drafter is active, but also proves this token threshold was too loose to demonstrate lower-batch-only activation. Matched Thinking-2507 baseline job 3088636 now has 4/4 baseline metrics: mean generated throughput 61.48 tok/s/GPU, mean E2E 44.72 tok/s/GPU, and mean total step time 452.20s. Versus that matched baseline, this always-enabled PublicHF run is slower: generation throughput 0.986x, E2E throughput 0.975x, and step-time speedup 0.952x. Strict lower-batch-only speedup is still unmeasured: rebuild strict-gate job 3092445 proved large-batch disable but failed before completed rollout metrics, and the next retry should use the validated V9 all-disabled path fix.

completed_metric_summary.comparison_note: 3084952 is not a strict lower-batch-only result because scheduler gate metrics stayed enabled_ratio=1.0 and disabled=0. Use 3092445 only as strict request-gate evidence; it is not a throughput result because it failed before completed rollout metrics.

submitted_runs.latest_observation: Resubmitted without dependency after cancelling startup_token-stalled job 3090318. slurm-3092445.out confirms NRL_FORCE_REBUILD_VENVS=true, UV_PYTHON=3.12.13, a fresh driver venv, policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507, request gate 4, token gate 0, the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 drafter, CUDA Graph mode via enforce_eager=false, p16/g32/GBS512, sequence packing, and max_steps=4. It reached Epoch 1/1 Step 1/4 generation, then failed after 03:08:55 elapsed with ExitCode 1:0. The important gate evidence is positive: vLLM logged NRL SpecDec batch gate checked=1 disabled=1 enabled=0 last_disabled=True requests=64 tokens=1856 request_threshold=4 token_threshold=0, and the dumped SchedulerOutput had scheduled_spec_decode_tokens={}. That proves strict lower-batch gating did disable draft work for the initial large batch. No completed rollout throughput or acceptance metric was emitted. The failure is Ray/vLLM execution hang on the all-disabled speculative_config path: RayChannelTimeoutError timed out waiting for object availability, RAY_CGRAPH_get_timeout was 3600 seconds, and the driver ended with RuntimeError: Failed to unpickle serialized exception. Treat this as a code-path/stability blocker for all-disabled batches, not as a drafter quality or speedup result.

failure_summary.interpretation: Lower-batch gate semantics worked, but the all-disabled vLLM speculative_config execution path still needs a baseline fallback or metadata-path fix before strict request-gated 235B throughput can be measured.
